name: toolsmenu-verify
description: Tools menu shows section headers (Analyse / Review & tour / Export & document).

steps.name: check-sections
steps.eval: (function(){var labels=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel .menu-label')).map(function(e){return e.textContent});var want=['Analyse','Review & tour','Export & document'];for(var i=0;i<want.length;i++){if(!labels.includes(want[i]))throw new Error('missing section '+want[i]+'; got '+labels.join('|'))}return 'sections-ok:'+labels.join('|')})()
